rationale: Haibo brings deep expertise in robot manipulation and data-efficient learning through geometric deep learning—research areas where Hercules is actively building robotics systems and exploring AI agent frameworks at Brex. Their shared focus on robotics-manipulation creates a natural foundation, while Hercules's experience scaling AI systems and emphasis on context management for agent effectiveness could directly inform how Haibo structures hierarchical, data-efficient approaches to robot learning at scale.
intro_message: Haibo Zhao, meet Hercules Giaretta Gimenes — you both work in robotics and AI systems, and Hercules's expertise in scaling AI agents and documentation practices could offer valuable perspective on deploying the kind of data-efficient, hierarchical approaches Haibo is pioneering in robot manipulation.
